stemMd: The major building programme on the Athenian Acropolis associated with Pericles belongs chiefly to which period?
explanationMd: UNESCO places the principal Acropolis building programme in the second half of the fifth century BCE. Pericles' political leadership and Pheidias' artistic guidance belong to that classical setting.

distractorRationale.d: This is associated with the construction of Hagia Sophia.
distractorRationale.a: This is far later than classical Athens.
distractorRationale.b: This is too early for the Periclean programme.
